text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday... Curren-chan. As for your 
present... I will give it to you properly 
later.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waah, thank you, Bouquet-chan! I always 
look forward to the flowers you give me 
every year~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. I'm glad. I took some photos—would 
you like to take a quick peek?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A photograph cannot convey the scent, but— 
I believe it turned out to be quite 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow... So cute~! Is the blue one in the 
middle a nemophila? What's the white one 
next to it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—...Orlaya. In the language of flowers, 
both mean 'lovely'. I thought... they'd be 
perfect for you, Curren-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. Thanks♪ Oh, what are those white and 
purple flowers in the photo next to it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The white is strawberry, and its language 
of flowers is 'affection.' The purple is 
nigella, meaning 'quiet joy.' Both are 
Curren-chan's birth flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by so much love—Curren-chan. 
Having that smile—by my side, as natural 
as can be. —That is my own—quiet joy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Okay then, okay then~... The baby 
blue eyes can be Curren, and the 
laceflower can be Bouquet-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because they're both "Curren," right? So 
one is Curren, and the other is 
Bouquet-chan. Curren and Bouquet-chan will 
be together forever and ever♪
